tools.name: ee_import
tools.description:
Import an uploaded workspace archive into a new workspace. Use an objectId for a completed archive upload; this is different from importing an ordinary file with ee_transfer.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","objectId":"put-upload-object-id-here"}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_fork
tools.description:
Create an independent workspace from an existing workspace's saved revision or named backup. Returns the new workspace ID without starting a runtime. Omit backupId/snapshotId to use the latest saved revision.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","source":{"workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here"}},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","source":{"workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","backupId":"put-backup-id-here"}}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_open
tools.description:
Create a workspace, or explicitly open an existing workspace in a session. Returns the workspace and session IDs. Omit workspaceId for new work; supply it to restore saved work. Use a new idempotency key for a new open request.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here"},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","timeouts":{"maxSessionSeconds":3600}}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_close
tools.description:
Save the workspace and close its session, releasing runtime resources. Later work can restore the saved workspace. Use mode: discard only to deliberately drop unsaved changes.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","mode":"save"}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_save
tools.description:
Save workspace files and supported settings so they can be restored later. Keeps an active session open. If a job is running, wait for it or explicitly choose busy: interrupt to stop it before saving.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","busy":"reject"}]

tools.name: ee_operation
tools.description:
Wait for a previously accepted operation and return its result. Use the operationId from a pending response; this also follows automatic reopen and its original action.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","operationId":"put-operation-id-here"}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_export_zip
tools.description:
Create a downloadable ZIP of selected workspace files or directories. Returns the download artifact for the interface. Automatically restores an eligible inactive workspace. Does not close the session.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","paths":["/workspace/reports","/workspace/README.md"],"filename":"project-results.zip"}]

tools.name: ee_settings

Set the session's working directory or explicit environment variables. Automatically restores an eligible inactive workspace. Save the workspace to preserve these supported settings for later sessions.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","directory":"/workspace","env":{"APP_MODE":"development"}}]

tools.name: ee_files
tools.description:
Work with files inside your workspace: list a directory, inspect metadata, read file contents, write a file, create a directory, move a path or delete a path. Choose action and provide its required fields. Automatically restores an eligible inactive workspace.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"list","path":"/workspace","limit":100},{"version":"1","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"stat","path":"/workspace/report.txt"},{"version":"1","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"read","path":"/workspace/report.txt","offset":0,"maxBytes":65536},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"write","path":"/workspace/report.txt","content":"Report ready\n","encoding":"utf8"},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"mkdir","path":"/workspace/reports"},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"move","path":"/workspace/report.txt","destination":"/workspace/reports/report.txt"},{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","action":"delete","path":"/workspace/reports/report.txt","recursive":false}]

tools.name: ee_exec
tools.description:
Run a CLI command in your workspace and return its output and exit status. Automatically restores an eligible inactive workspace. Supply either command, or executable with argv. Waits by default.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","executable":"/usr/bin/python3","argv":["-c","print(2 + 2)"],"timeoutSeconds":30}]

wait.description: Await the durable result by default for ordinary execution, files, settings, lifecycle and job/operation reads. Set false to return immediately. Background execution always returns immediately.

tools.name: ee_run_code
tools.description:
Run Python, Node.js or TypeScript source in your workspace and return output and exit status. Automatically restores an eligible inactive workspace. Use source for the code.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","language":"python","source":"from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/workspace/report.txt')
p.write_text('Report ready\n')
print(p.read_text())","timeoutSeconds":30}]

tools.name: ee_job
tools.description:
Wait for an existing command job and retrieve its output, exit status or failure details. Use jobId from the original request; this does not rerun the command.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","jobId":"put-job-id-here","maxBytes":65536}]

Request cancellation of an existing job and wait for its resulting state. Cancellation does not undo file changes already made.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","jobId":"put-job-id-here"}]

tools.name: ee_profiles
tools.description:
List available execution profiles, supported languages, default resource limits and timeout limits. Does not start a session.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1"}]

tools.name: ee_status
tools.description:
Read workspace or session state, saved revision and expiry information. Does not reopen the environment.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here"}]

tools.name: ee_list
tools.description:
List your workspaces, or the saved revisions or named backups of one workspace. Does not start a session. Use the returned cursor only when more results remain.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","kind":"workspaces","limit":25},{"version":"1","kind":"backups","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","limit":10}]

tools.name: ee_export
tools.description:
Export a saved workspace revision as a workspace archive for later import. Does not export unsaved changes or start a session. Use ee_export_zip when the user wants ordinary project files in a ZIP.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","source":{"workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here"},"selfContained":true,"includeLogs":false}]

tools.name: ee_backup
tools.description:
Keep a named restore point for this workspace. Saves current work first by default. Keeps up to 10 named backups per workspace; creating another removes the oldest after the new backup succeeds.
Keep workspaceId for later work. Each new mutation requires a unique idempotencyKey; retries reuse the same key and arguments. Example inputs (replace put-… placeholders):
[{"version":"1","idempotencyKey":"put-key-here","workspaceId":"put-workspace-id-here","name":"before-data-cleanup","saveFirst":true,"busy":"reject"}]
